name: AddToDateTimeNode
label: Add Time to DateTime
description: Adds a specified time value to the given DateTime based on the selected time unit.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: BaseDateTime
fields.label: Base DateTime
fields.description: The original DateTime value to which the time should be added.

fields.name: ValueToAdd
fields.label: Value to Add
fields.description: The numeric value of time to add to the DateTime.

fields.name: TimeUnit
fields.label: Time Unit
fields.description: Specifies the unit of time (e.g., Seconds, Minutes, Hours, Days, Months, Years).

fields.name: ResultDateTime
fields.label: Updated DateTime
fields.description: The resulting DateTime after the specified value has been added.
